resolutions.title: orbit_output admits any Bash call naming the orbit/ directory, so a trail listing passes the printed-path graders
resolutions.evidence: Reproduced at HEAD: RUNS_ORBIT matched orbit after any whitespace, so `find orbit -name ...` counted as an orbit call. Probed further: orbit's own `status --change greet-name --boot` answer over the review and walk seeds prints a seeded review-system / address-reviews path, which passed those cases' printed-path graders with no new record.
resolutions.action: trace.mjs counts a Bash call only when orbit is the first word of one of its commands (start, or after ; && || | ( $( backtick or a line break, past NAME=value prefixes). Printed-path graders carry after_seed: true and pass only on a path whose timestamp is later than the seed's newest trail record; buildFixture's newestTrailToken is recorded per run as seed_token and passed to grading, and an after_seed grader refuses to grade without it. resolutions.title: An interrupted or crashing run writes no record, and its detached session keeps billing
resolutions.evidence: At HEAD the record was written once, at the end (flag wx), and graders loaded inside the loop; a SIGINT killed the runner but not the detached session.
resolutions.action: run.mjs writes the record before the first session (flag wx) and rewrites it after every run; every selected case's graders load before any build or spend; SIGINT/SIGTERM kills the running session's process group, which counts its whole budget, records the remaining runs as interrupted, writes the record and exits 130. runner.test.ts covers Ctrl-C mid-session and a malformed grader in a later case; mutations removing the early write or the kill were shown caught.
